corrections.before:
but he also possesses the strength of character and wisdom
necessary for the prosperity of our country.
corrections.after:
but does he also possess the strength of character and wisdom
needed to lead a good life that benefits the people of our country?
corrections.reason: Restore the narrator's doubt about Zargon as a question, not praise.

corrections.before:
Before leaving, I whispered to
Simona to save some morsels from the feast and suggested that we meet shortly before midnight in
the castle basement for a private gathering.
corrections.after:
Before I left, Simona whispered to me that she had kept some morsels from the feast in the
kitchen. If I wanted to, I could meet her shortly before midnight in the castle basement,
where we would enjoy our own little feast.
corrections.reason: Simona has already saved food and invites the tower guard, not the reverse.

corrections.before:
Well you have to admit, with a slight
smile on your face, that you have
actually been playing with your thoughts
over the last few weeks, sitting at home
while while your parents were out
partying. And one night you finally
realized, you are almost forced to
travel - if only to show your parents
whos the boss in the house!
corrections.after:
Well, you have to admit with a slight
smile that, over the last few weeks, you
had been thinking of staying at home
while your parents were away and
throwing a huge party. But then you
realized that you really had to go on
holiday - if only to show your parents
who was boss!
corrections.reason: Dave considers throwing a party while his parents are away; the parents are not out partying.

corrections.before:
Happy and full of the
energy that you used
to have when you were
in school, and that
isnt normal now, you
enter your hotel,
sign the guestbook,
and receive your room
key.
corrections.after:
Happy and full of energy - quite unlike
you during the school term - you enter
your hotel, ring for the porter at
reception, sign the guestbook and
collect your room key.
corrections.reason: Dave's energy is unusual during school, not something he had in the past; restore the reception sequence.

corrections.before:

corrections.after:

corrections.reason: He plans to report his arrival later, not tell stories after returning home.
